note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry gives Mayotte no IBAN of its own: the prefix FR of France includes it, so an account there is numbered as one in France.

sources.title: SWIFT, IBAN Registry (ISO 13616), its text release: the copy in GNU Taler's iban-tools (registry.txt, commit 81b6dbcb, 2025-02-18; its latest country update December 2024), read there because swift.com answered every request with HTTP 403 on 2026-10-30
sources.said: IBAN prefix country code (ISO 3166): FR | Country code includes other countries/territories: GF, GP, MQ, RE, PF, TF, YT, NC, BL, MF (French part), PM, WF
